translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs Atwzlrpx-ngrde Aposol Nedeng Mz Nzlepx-krdr Nrpakxmrlz
Jiszs kqleleng aposol kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) x sc tqayrlwr-amqmupeleng. X mz nzmnclz-krbzlr bade, kabzle badr nzxplrngr x zmatq ngr nzmaszlrpx-krdr drka' amrlx x nzamrlz-krdr kxnzyagoxng.

Zbz atwzlrpxpe-ngrdeng mz mztea kcng trkrlzkapzlrng. Rpibzle kx nayapwxtipxlr Nrpakxmrlz kx Gct sa tqvectrpemle leplz mz nzmnclz-krbzlr bade mz nzngini-krde King rdr. X na-amrlzlr nrkrdrtq leplz kx nzyagoxng.
Rpi-mopwzle badr kx, “Bzkq da kx natwzamu mz nzvzpx-krmu, kx apule nctoko, bxli, dakxnzng, x srlrni. X bzkq nimu kx nartwz kz nzkq krali. Murde na-abrtrpzmu drtwrmu mz Gct nzrka-krde.
Drlve ke nzaodu-ngrmu, mncpepwzmu mz ma lapwz esz' navz, nakrlzbzle mzli kx narlasz-ngrnamu mztea la.
Drlve ke leplz trnzaodu-ngrdru nimu, rlaszamu mztea la x rtc-ngrbzmu rplz nakrlz-ngrdrle kx nqmq krdr trka mz nzapu-krdr kxnzmnc-mrbrng.”
Aposol kcng nzrkalzmqng, sc tzvz-zlipelr mztea kcng amrlx. Tzyapwxtipxlr Nrpakxmrlz kc x tzamrlzting leplz kx nzyagoxng mrkc atwrnrngr.
King Herot Antipas Xlrle Nrpa Ngr Jiszs

Zbz King Herot Antipas, kc tqaclvele lr Gzlili, xlrle nrpa ngr da kcng tqaleting Jiszs x ncblo nedeng. Drtwrde mrbrtxtrpz, murde mzli kc kai pibzle mz kzdung ncblo ngr vea nedeng nanibqlr Jon. A' kzdung leplz tzrpilr kx, “Jon Kxawrkxtr tulzpe-mop mz nzbzngr.”
Kzdung nzrpilr kx profet Elaeja kc bqnc, tqmatq tqadcpx-lzbqpe. X kzdung nzrpilr kx kzdq kz profet ngr mzli kc lupe mou.
Rpi Herot kx, “Nar Jon lakipxpe kzdung ncblo ngr vea. ?A' nelc krlc tqxlrx tqaleti da lcng?” X sc tqrpile namcle Jiszs.
Jiszs Apuleng Ncblo Siu-nzlvqn (5,000)

Aposol kcng sc tzyzlupemqng mz nzryapwxpx-krdr Nrpakxmrlz x nzamrlz-krdr leplz kxnzyagoxng, sc tzpipebzlr mz Jiszs da kcng amrlx tzalelr. Zbz sc tzvzpxpeng me esotrpz mz kzdq taon drtqde Betsaeda murde namnc-ngrdr esz'-krdr.

A' kx nzxlrbz zbo ngr leplz kcng le, sc tzvz-nqblqpelr nide. Kx nzkrlzbzlr nide, sc tqaodupele nidr. X sc tqycmnetr-ngrbzle badr kx Gct sa tqvectrpemle leplz mz nzmnclz-krbzlr bade mz nzngini-krde King rdr. X amrlzle krkcng tzyagoxng.

A' mzli kcpe mz milzpq, aposol kcng nzvzmqng bade sc tzrpipebzlr kx, “Kxetu, atwzlrpxngr leplz lcng mz mztea x nrlanc kcng tzyctineng mrlc, murde namwing x narmctineng nadr dakxnzng. Murde trpnzngr me narmctingr leplz lcng dakxnzng.”
A' Jiszs rpibzle badr kx, “Nimu kx narkabz nadr dakxnzng.” Nzrpibzlr kx, “Yctxpqng bagr bret nzlvqn kxtopwztine x nc kxsupe li. Takitxtrpwzle nzvz-krgr nzxpe-krgr dakxnzng nang zbo ngr leplz lc.”

(Murde ncblo nzkqlu-krdr nzesolzbzng mz siu kx nzlvqn (5,000). A' trnzrlwxtrpwzu olvz x doa kx nztopwzng.) Rpibz Jiszs mz ncblo nedeng kx, “Awxbuamu leplz mz dzbedeng. Mz dzbede kxesz' leplz nakrlzbzle nzpnu kxnzlvqn (50).”
X sc tzawxbutiopelrng.
Jiszs kalzmle bret kcng nzlvqn x nc kcng li, x obqlz mz bongavz mz nzkrka'ngr x sc tqawipebz mz Gct. Zbz lopxitxdeng, x sc tqkapebzleng mz ncblo nedeng, tzakipxbzlr mz leplz kcng nzkqlung.
Leplz amrlx nzmung x nelzdr krlctxtrpz, x ncblo nedeng nznulvzo-moulr topla nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) mz nctq dakxnzng kx yctxo.
Pita Glxle Kx Jiszs Nide Kxnzmcpx
Kzdq zbq, mzli kx Jiszs krka'-ngrde esz'-krde, ncblo nedeng nzvzmqng bade, sc tqveapebz badr, rpibzle kx, “?Myx kxmu nzglxkr leplz ninge?”
Nzrpibzlr kx, “Nzkqlung nzrpilr kx nim Jon Kxawrkxtr tulzpe-mop mz nzbzngr. Kzdung nzrpilr kx nim Elaeja. X kzdu-kzng nzrpilr kx nim dq profet kc bqnc tqlupe mou.”
Rpibzle kx, “?A' nimu, myx kxmu nzglx-krnamu ninge?” Rpibz Pita kx, “Kxnzmcpx ne Gct.”
Zbz Jiszs rngidrlvz-ngrbzle badr kx trkrlzkapzle mzli r nzyapwxtine-krbzlr mz leplz nzngini-krde Kxnzmcpx.
Jiszs Ycmnetr-ngrde Nzbz-krde X Kxnamu Nzrvz-nqblqngr Nide

Sc tqrpipebz Jiszs kx, “Ninge, Mrlx Leplz, drtqnge naetqtx zlwz, x natrkalrpx-ngrdr ninge lrtzlvz ngrgung, nidr badr kxnzetu rdr pris, x kxnzalvztrng mz Lou sc Mosis. Sa nanibqlr ninge, a' sa na-atulz-mople ninge Gct Trte mz zbq kratq mz nibr nzbz-krnge.”

Zbz sc tqrpipebzle badr amrlx ngrdr kx, “Doa kx navz-nqblq-angidrle ninge, narlrpx-lzbq mz nzaetq-ngrbz drtqde mz zbq kang kqlu. X naesablqtile me pnz drtwrde esz'-krde, x bzkq axtxbzle nzo-zli-krde lrpzki rnge.
Murde doa kx otr-zvzngr drtwrde nzlu-krde, sa namale-lvile nzlungr kxboi. A' krkc tqyrlqtxole nzlu-krde murde lxngitile ninge, sa naprtr mz nzlungr kxboi.
Mane nznginingr bcnyr mz nrlc ka x amrbrtxtrle nzlu-krde mz nrlc kc navzm.
Doa kx pxtxpx-ngrde ninge x natqngeng mz nzngini-krnge Mrlx Leplz, sa napxtxpx-kz-ngrne nide mzli kc nayzlu-ngr-mopwc' mz zluli rnge x zluli r Trtenge x enjrl kxnztrng.
A' napi-angidrbo bamu kx kzdung nimu sa nalubeng mzli kc Gct na-aelwapx-ngrde zmatq ngrde mz nzvectr-krmle leplz mz nzmnclz-krbzlr bade mz nzngini-krde King rdr.”
Nrkrdrtq Jiszs Tekqtr-lzbq
Mwx zbq rtqmz otx, mz nibr Jiszs nzpi-krbzle da lcng, vzmileng Pita, Jon, x Jemes x sc tzvzdzpeng mz kzdq newz murde Jiszs nakrka'.
Mzli kcpwz tqkrka'-ngrde, Jiszs mzte kc tqblepxpengr x lrpz scde kc tqpnaprtxpxpe.
Nzpwrkilvc-ngrdr ncblo nzling, Mosis x Elaeja, kcng tztupeng badr Jiszs mrkc, tzycmnepeng.
Ncblo lcng nzadcpx-lzbqng mz zluli kxetu, sc tzycmnetrpe-ngrdr kxnamu nzatutrkr Jiszs me pnz drtwr Gct mz nzbz-krde Jerusalem.
Mzli lcde Pita nidr badr kztedeng nzmwipeng. A' kx nzdwalzmlr, sc tzmcpelr zluli r Jiszs, x nzmcpe-kzlr ncblo kcng nzling tztung badr.

Mzli kc ncblo kcng nzling tzrpilr nzrlaszpe-ngrdr Jiszs, sc tqrpipebz Pita mz Jiszs kx, “Kxakrlz, mrlztx angidr nzmnc-krgu mrka. Mwx nawztibzkr du matelq natq, nangi nyzm dq, nyz dq Mosis x nyz dq Elaeja.” (Trkrlz-angidrleu da kc tqpile.)
Mzli kc tqycmnebe-ngrde, kzdq dcbz aelwapx-lzbqngr x akqlvztxde nidr mz zmyo ngrde. X nzmwxlrtx-pnzng.
Natq Gct vzpxm mz dcbz kc. Rpibzle badr kx, “Krlc mrlxnge Kxnzmcpx. Lalztqbzmu bade!”
Natq kc kx esakitxde, Jiszs kc tqtutxpe mrkc esz'-krde. Da lcng yc-lrpitxtrpwz badr Pita, Jon x Jemes. A' trpnzngr kx nzpi-nebadrle mzli lcde.
Rblxbz Mz Ncblo Neng Jiszs Nzrmaszlrpx-krdr Drka'
Nrlc ngrlxobz sc tzvzopemqng mz newz kc. Zbz zbo ngr leplz kxetu sc tzrmctipeng Jiszs badr Pita, Jon x Jemes.
Kzdq ncblo sc tqkabopxpem mz nabz zbo ngr leplz kcng. Rpipxmle kx, “Kxakrlz! Mctxbz ena mrlxnge, murde mrlxnge delcpwz esz'txu!
Kzdq drka' mncpxm bade, x mzli kx dwatitr-ngrde mrlxnge, sc tqanepele nide. X batrpzle nzglqkr nimzle, vz vz mzli kx nqbya ngr naode wxbutr-ngrbzle. Tqatakrtibzle drtqde, x waisr-zvz-ngrde nide!
Yrnititrpo mz ncblo nemqng kx namaszlrpx-ngrbzlr bade. A' trnzyatrpwzung.”
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “?Nike nawai-mopwc' bamu? Nzmnc-krbo bamu mzli boipe! A' trkrlzkalamu nzrlxngitingr x narmu kc tqmqngibe.” Zbz sc tqrpipebzle mz ncblo kc kx, “Vzmim mrlxm mrka.”
Doa ncblo kc kx vzmle, drka' kc sc tqrtcope-ngrde nide mz drtc' x sc tqngi-batrpebzle nzglqkr nimzle. Jiszs pnanatile drka' kc. Amrlzle doa ncblo kc, x sc tqavzpebzle mz trtede.
Leplz amrlx nzkctitxpxlr zmatq ngr Gct kc tqmyalz.
Nzwrde Krali Kx Ycmnetrngr Jiszs Nzbz-krde
Mzli kc leplz mztr tqprtxbe-ngrde x naodr tqmztxbe-ngrde mz nzrkctipx-krdr, Jiszs kc tqrpipebzle mz ncblo nedeng kx,
“Da lc napibo bamu bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrmu! Ninge Mrlx Leplz sa na-aprcbz mz zmatq ngr kxnzmwati drtwrdr ninge.”
A' trnzkrlzlru nike drtwr ngrde. Nzyrlq-kapqbz badr x tryrplatitru nardr. A' nzmwxlrtilr nzveati-krbzlr nzycmnengr lc.
Doa Kx Myalz-zlwzbz Mz Nzobqkr Gct
Kzdq mzli, ncblo neng Jiszs tztalwzti-lzbq-ngrdr neke mz nidr kx myapxbz.
Krlztrpebz Jiszs da kx tqpnz drtwrdr, zbz otile kc kzdq doa kxtopwz sc tqatupele mz nrlarde.

X sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “Mrlx kx vz-nqblqle ninge mz nzabrtzlvz-krde doa kxtopwz mz drtqnge, abrtzlvz-kzle ninge. X mrlx tqabrtzlvzle ninge, abrtzlvz-kzle Trte kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle ninge. Murde mrlx kx avzo-lzbq, nide kx myalz-zlwzbz mz mz Gct.”
Mrlx Kx Prtr Mz Nrlarde Nyz Jiszs
Jon rpibzle mz Jiszs kx, “Kxetu rnge, mckr kc ncblo kx rmaszlrpxngr drka' mz drtqm. A' pibzkr bade kx naesakipe, murde trprtrpuu bagu.”
Rpibz Jiszs bade kx, “Bzkq! Murde mrlx kx tr-rpwa'-ngrbzleu bamu nzale-krmu nzwz-krmu, tukile mz nrlarde nyzmu.”
Kzdung Lr Szmariz Nzpxtxpx-ngrdr Jiszs
Zbq trkqlupeu kx ycbep mz nzbzkr Jiszs x sc tzvzmilzpe Heven, sc tqaoti-angidrpe drtwrde nzvz-krde Jerusalem.
Atwzlr-ngrde kcng menrpa nedeng kx nartwayz-kaipzng bade. X sc tzvztrpeng mz kzdq mztea ngr Szmariz mz nzoliqti-krbzlr dakxnzng x ma kx namwi-ngrdr.
A' leplz kcng mrkc nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzadwatr-krdr nide, murde opx angidr kx nzvz-krde la navzkile Jerusalem. Tzwai-ngrdr da lc murde lr Szmariz nztrkabzng badr lr Jiu x mzteadau Jerusalem.
Kx nzxlrpe Jemes nidr mz Jon da lc, sc tzrpipebzlr mz Jiszs kx, “?Kxetu rgr, trnakqlelzkakr nyr Heven navzom x na-atrkatile nidr?”
A' Jiszs o-lxlvrbz sc tqlclvzpebzle. {X rpibzle badr kx, “Drka' la tqbatrpzle nzycmne-krmu lc. Murde ninge Mrlx Leplz trvz-ngrpwc'u nzodati-krnge nzlukr leplz, a' vz-ngrmc nzarlapxngr nidr.”}
X sc tzvzkipelr mztea kzble.
Drtwr Naesz'ti Mz Nzrvz-nqblqngr Jiszs
Mzli kc tzvzpe-ngrdr, kzdq ncblo rpibzle mz Jiszs kx, “Sa navz-nqblqx nim drlve keng vzkiq.”

A' rpibz Jiszs kx, “?Krlz-angidr-kzq da kx ycpxm mz nzrvz-nqblqngr ninge? Murde fokis nzmnc-zpwxng mz ma nyzdr kx yclzm mz gq. X utc nzmnc-zpwx-kzng mz ma nyzdr kx ngi nrla nounc. A' ninge Mrlx Leplz, trmnc-zpwxwxu, murde lr mrnyzngeng nzpxtxpx-ngrdr ninge. X sa napxtxpx-kz-ngrdr nim. ?Myx kxmule, navz-nqblqpeq ye ninge?”
Rpibz Jiszs mz kzdq kz ncblo kx, “Vz-nqblqm ninge.” A' rpibz ncblo kc kx, “Kxetu, na-ale-kaipo me pnz drtwr trtenge mzli ka, a' mz nibr nzbz-krde sc tqvz-nqblq-atex nim.”
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Trtingr! Rlrpe-ngrbz ye mz krkcng mqngrdr nzbzpeng nzyrtzmq-krdr kxnginidr kx nabzng.”
Kzdq kz ncblo rpibzle kx, “Navz-nqblqbo nim, kx Kxetu. A' navztx-kaipo mz trtenge narlxtibo bade kx rlr-ngrmle o trtingr.”

Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Ncblo kx ryabo nrlanc a' matinetr drtwrde, trnatwzleu dalr nrlanc. X mz nqmq lcpwz, mane nzpnzkr drtwr doa nzmnclz-krbzle mz Gct mz drtwrde nzlitr-krbzle. Murde rblx nzvectr-krbzle leplz mz Gct mz nzngini-krde King rdr.”

footnotes.text: 9:23 Jiszs pi-angidrle kx, “Naglqlzle kros ngrde.” Kros drtwr ngrde nzaetqtingr drtq. 9:27 Kxnzetung mz Nzryrngrkxtr, mz drtwrdr natq lc ngidatipe mz kzdq mzli lcng tq: mz mzli r nztekqtr-lzbqkr nrkrdrtq Jiszs, mz mzli r nztulz-krmle mz nzbzngr, o mz mzli r nzvzo-krm Mqngrkxtr mz nibr nzvzdzkr Jiszs Heven. Murde mz mzli lcng tq, Jiszs vectrple leplz bade mz nzlxngiti-krdr nide.
Natq Gct lc drtwr ngrde kx nzalvztrkr Jiszs myaszpxle Lou sc Mosis x nzryrkr profet amrlx. [Sam 2:7; Asaea 42:1; Matiu 3:17; Mak 1:11; Luk 3:22; Lou Kcpwz 18:15; 2 Pita 1:17-18]
9:55 Mz kzdung nzryrngr kcng pnz natq lcng tqycpxm mz { } trnzyroung elr.

9:58 Natq angidr kx pi Jiszs nidr seleng: “Trpnzngr nyznge ma kx na-ama-ngrne.” A' leplz kxnzkqlung nzrpilr kx fokis drtwr ngrde King Herot kc trngi-angidru lr Jiu. X utc drtwr ngrde lr Rom kcng trngiulrJiu. X lr ma nyz Jiszs drtwr ngrde lr Jiu. Kxmule-esz' lr Jiu nzabrtzlvzlr kxnzetu kcng trngiulrJiu, a' nzpxtxpx-ngrdr Jiszs, kc tqngi angidr lr Jiu. 9:60 Nzrvz-nqblqngr Jiszs namyaszpxle nzrvz-nqblqngr nqmq ngr lr mrnyzm.
